## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `2520f4d33398b7113fc01402b980835989287ab6`
Local-runs: none
Scope: docs/adr/0084-application-builder-information-architecture.md, docs/adr/0146-studio-designs-setup-administers-one-editor-per-item-paired-customize-package.md + none
Security-touching: yes

PR #37470, card #37451 of epic #37424. Two files, +229/−8, text only, merge base `a46efa8c`. Read: the card's body and all ten comments (the rulings and the four dev reports, 7187678959 last), the epic's body, ruling records 7184753035, 7185703578 and 7187264388, the phase-table comment 7184108099 the diff cites, the net diff, and the 48 check-runs on the head (none failed). The cited code and ADRs were read in the tree at the head; nothing was built or run.

`Security-touching: yes` is meant. No hunk adds a mechanism, and there is no security finding, but three hunks teach security-relevant behaviour: the kernel refusing a package-less create, with its four named exemptions and the `.custom` binding of organization-authored sharing rules, queues and assignment rules (ADR-0084, Organization-level content); where the cross-package directory of access metadata — positions, permission sets, capabilities, sharing rules — is administered (ADR-0084 Placements; ADR-0146 D1); and the read-only package gate with a switcher that lists "the packages the person may open" (ADR-0084, The frame).

### ① Derived judgments

- **Accept-set and public surface of this diff: none.** No schema, no code, no test, no generated file. Right.
- **What the text declares for later, each named as later and each right to defer:**
  - `dataset` registered `data` instead of `ui` in `DEFAULT_METADATA_TYPE_REGISTRY` — the text itself says it is a change to the spec's contract and owes a contract review in its own card. At the head the row still reads `domain: 'ui'`.
  - The kernel closing package-less creates (ADR-0070 D1) — a narrowing, phase 4; the text says the kernel does not do it yet, which the tree confirms (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-package-scope.ts` still words a save "without naming a package" as a way out).
  - `STUDIO_APP`'s display label, the menu rows of `datasource`, `position`, `dataset` and `form`, the frame — all UI cards.
- **The pinned table.** `studioMenuPlacement.test.ts` reads the ADR's type-to-group rows. The 32 rows its pattern matches are byte-identical between `origin/main` and the head, so the pin holds by construction. The UI test lanes were skipped on this head (docs-only filter), so no check-run measured it; the dev's local 12/12 is the only run.
- **ADR gates.** `Lint · docs & code guards` and `Check Documentation Links` are green. By construction: every in-file anchor the diff uses is defined once (`#amendment-2026-11-26` and its seven parts; `#d1`, `#d3` in ADR-0146); the diff adds no `path:NNN` line anchor; all eight symbol anchors resolve at the head — `studio.app.ts#STUDIO_APP`, `StudioBackToApp.tsx#studioBackTarget`, `PackageFormDialog.tsx#PackageFormDialog`, `StudioPackageMenu.tsx#STUDIO_PACKAGE_MENU_ITEMS`, `StudioItemHeader.tsx#StudioItemHeader`, `ShellPageActions.tsx#ShellPageActions`, `dataset.zod.ts#DatasetSchema`, `metadata-plugin.zod.ts#DEFAULT_METADATA_TYPE_REGISTRY` — and the three file-level paths exist. No anchor names a missing file. The title is unchanged, so the `docs/adr/README.md` row is unchanged.
- **The removed "Open" part.** `amendment-2026-11-26-open` has no occurrence anywhere in the tree at the head — docs, skills, `.claude/`, scripts, code comments, other ADRs — and no file links any ADR-0084 anchor from outside the file. Nothing on `main` could cite it: the section never landed.

### ② Semver level

`skip-changeset` is right: `docs/adr/**` is not published, and the diff changes no package. `Clause-②: no` is right: no accept-set moves in this diff. `Metadata-protocol: none` is right.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Dev flags.** The final report (7187678959) carries `open_questions: []`. Its three `out_of_scope_findings` are answered: the removed anchor (confirmed unlinked, ① above); the phase-2 note on the ⋯ rows (agrees with ruling 1 = B as written); the phase-3 note that D1's "no metadata catalog" is already narrowed (agrees with the ADR-0146 paragraph).
- **The area's three notes (7188063715).** Note 1 confirmed. Note 2 confirmed: item 7 is a pointer, items 8–11 keep their numbers, and ruling record 7187264388 names the point "Item 7". Note 3 is N1 below.
- **Escalated to the maintainer, by the hand-off and not by a change to the text:** item 11 (N1). The seat's Tier H hand-off must name it in the maintainer's language as a point he has not ruled; the PR body's speed-read already does.
- **SQL push-down.** Not applicable: no query, no id materialisation, no join in the diff.

### ④ Design judgment

No must-fix, no should-fix.

**Rulings against the text, sentence by sentence.**

- Question 1 = B (7187264388): written exactly. 概览 carries edit, export, duplicate, publish, revert and a "Manage in Setup" link; disable, enable and delete stay in Setup → Packages; no second home for the three dialogs; decision 9's three rows are said not to be carried. The phase-1 ⋯ keeps today's six rows, which the tree confirms (`edit, export, duplicate, revert, adopt, manage`) — none of the three is among them.
- Questions 2 = A and 3 = C (7184753035): the four exemptions, `os meta register` closed, UI ask and kernel close in one phase with the kernel last, in-place saves of loose rows open, the `.custom` binding with no new exemption, loose items legal under ADR-0150 D1 bucket 4, one door for a selection, `adopt-orphans` and `~org` retiring together — all as recorded. One clause is dropped (N3).
- Question 4 = yes: `dataset` and `position` are 常用 by name, and the 2026-11-25 rule is not reworded — as the record asks.
- Question 5: "a Setup group that holds access pages", not Diagnostics. The record says "an access-related Setup group"; the two read the same, and Setup has such a group today (`group_access_control`). The entry is left to its card, which the ruling also leaves.
- Item 7 = A: Diagnostics stays in Studio, on a package it reads that package (the tree confirms: `MetadataDiagnosticsPage` passes the area's `packageId`), Setup → Diagnostics keeps audit log, sessions and notification events (confirmed in `setup-nav.contributions.ts`), and an environment-wide sweep rides the `~all` directory. ADR-0146 D1 stands, and the earlier head's mark at "diagnostics" is gone.
- `form` in 常用 (7185703578): tier by name, group by registered domain. The order inside the tier is N1.
- The pick 「按推荐启动」: the five homes match the card's list. The top bar was read at the head and does hold seven things; the two beyond the pick are attributed correctly (decision 3; "not ruled", item 5).
- Every 「…」 the diff adds was found in the epic's body, the card, a ruling record, or ADR text already on `main`.

**Findings.**

- N1 (nit) — **Item 11 is a decision the maintainer has not made, and the text says so correctly.** Ruling record 7185703578 states under "What it does not rule" that the place of `form` among 界面's 常用 types is not ruled. The amendment writes "fifth, after `report`" in three places (the `form` bullet, the 界面 order list, the 2026-11-25 mark) and flags it once, as item 11, under "Merging accepts them; an objection names the number". That is the same carrier as the nine other live items of the list, and the one this record used on 2026-11-24 and 2026-11-25. The choice is also the least-moving one: the four ruled types keep their order, and the area's "directly after `view`" is impossible for a 常用 type. No change to the text is owed. It need not be held on a separate card or turned back into an "Open" part: the maintainer merges this PR, and the merge is the ruling. What the record asks: the hand-off names item 11 to the maintainer in plain words, and if he wants another place, the order of that one row is edited before merge.
- N2 (nit) — **Three sentences the amendment narrows are not marked**, against its own line "each sentence this replaces or narrows is marked where it stands … everything not marked stands". The `datasource` example is marked at the first reading of the table but not where it recurs: the 2026-11-24 "What stands" row ("Its example moves: a `datasource` is found under 平台 Platform") and item 2 of that day's list ("`datasource` under 平台 Platform"). The 2026-11-24 note at the top still reads "Studio is the development surface of one app". The decision is unambiguous in the 2026-11-26 "replaces / stands" table, so this is tidiness.
- N3 (nit) — **One clause of ruling 3 is dropped.** The record says the door "runs each item through the save door's judges, judging the selection as a set for the ADR-0150 D3 (a) cross-boundary rule". The text keeps "runs each through the judges a save runs" and loses the set judgement. It cites the record and says it follows it, so the phase-4 card has the full wording one link away.
- N4 (nit) — **`form` is called "a type registered after this ruling"** in the mark on the 2026-11-25 tiers paragraph. At the head and on `origin/main` the registry has no `form` row (PR #37422 is open), as the same amendment says further down ("no `form`"). "To be registered" is the true tense. The bullet's "the card that registers the type keeps it out of Studio's directory" likewise describes an open PR.
- N5 (nit) — **The "Decided by" list of epic decisions that a ruling changed is one short.** It names decision 9's disable, enable and delete. Ruling 1 = B also undoes the sub-line of decision 1, "It revises ADR-0146's split, which kept disable and delete in Setup". The body gets it right (the position bullet and the ADR-0146 paragraph both keep the three in Setup); only the enumeration is incomplete.
- N6 (nit) — **ADR-0146: the 2026-11-24 note that follows D1 says "D1 and the amendment above speak of Studio".** The new dated paragraph now sits between that note and the amendment it meant. The sentence is still true of both.
- N7 (nit, follow-up) — **ADR-0159 D10 still reads "ADR-0084 needs no change"** with no pointer, while ADR-0084 now says `form` needs a row. The file is outside this card's claimed surface; the mark belongs to the card that writes the row (#37087), as ADR-0070's D1 and D5 marks belong to phase 4. The pin test fails without the row, so the gap cannot land silently.

**Read and found consistent.** No D-number is added or reused. The ADR-0146 status pointer, the mark on the Scope bullet, the mark at "no metadata catalog" and the dated paragraph agree with each other and with ADR-0084. ADR-0146 D3's switcher sentence ("folds `hotcrm.custom` under HotCRM") is unmarked on `main`, so "in force again" is accurate. ADR-0146 D5's note does say the app shell draws no top bar from 768 px up. ADR-0070 D2's amendment carries 「大包 + 设置里启用模块」 and #28117; D1, D5 and D6 say what the text says of them. ADR-0150 D1's fourth bucket and D7 say what the text says. ADR-0159 D2 holds the registry row with `domain: 'ui'`. The three order lists are consistent with the 2026-11-25 table plus the three placements, and "thirteen" counts right. The frame drawing omits 平台 Platform above the fold, which is correct: it holds no 常用 type.

**Left for the cards, noted so they are not lost.** (a) Whether 全部类型 All types still lists `datasource` once the menu draws no row for it — the 2026-11-25 text says the directory "lists every type of the six groups". (b) ADR-0146 D3's line per package ("n customized, m switched off") named "the package's own Studio overview" as a candidate home; 概览 is now defined with 「我们的修改 … 都不要放在首页」, and the amendment does not say where that line lives. Neither is decided by this PR, and neither needs to be.

**Hand-off.** Tier H by path; the maintainer merges. This record does not lift that. The PR is a draft with labels `documentation`, `size/m`, `skip-changeset`.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：ADR-0084 第三次修订（App Studio 框架），以及 ADR-0146 D1 的标注。只改两份 ADR 文档，不改代码。内容是把你对 #37451 的裁决写成定稿：
  - Q1 选 B；
  - Q2、Q3 按记录 7184753035；
  - Q4 选「是」；
  - Q5 放进访问分组；
  - 诊断留在 Studio；
  - form 放进「常用」（记录 7185703578）。
- 为什么：App Studio 改版专题 #37424 的第一步。先定框架，后面的卡按它做。
- **唯一需要你确认的一处：第 11 条把 form 排在「界面 常用」的第五位。** 你的裁决只说 form 进「常用」，没说排第几。合并即视为同意这个顺序。不同意的话，告诉我顺序，我让区改。
- 风险：只改文档。复核逐条对照了裁决，也核对了代码现状。没有新增或重复的 D 编号，删掉的 `-open` 段落在仓库里没有任何引用。涉及访问控制与包权限的描述，所以加了 `security` 标签，但没有安全问题。
- 要你做什么：批准合并（你亲自合并）。契约复核 PASS 在评论 7188270415，Head-sha `2520f4d33398b7113fc01402b980835989287ab6`。

席位意见：ACCEPT。逐条与裁决一致，7 条 nit 都是措辞或时态，不影响决定。

   - N2: three narrowed sentences are unmarked (the `datasource` examples and the "development surface of one app" note).
   - N3: one clause of ruling 3 (the ADR-0150 D3 (a) set judgement) is cited, not restated.
   - N4: "a type registered after this ruling" for `form`, which is still pending in #37422.
   - N5: the "Decided by" list names decision 9 only.

5. **Out of scope and where it went**:
   - N7, ADR-0159 D10 "ADR-0084 needs no change", goes to #37087, whose pin test fails without the row.
   - Area ux-37424 carries N2–N6 into the next ADR touch or a docs card under #37424.
   - Also for #37424's later cards: whether 全部类型 still lists `datasource`, and where ADR-0146 D3's line per package lives.
6. **Landing terms**: Tier H (`docs/adr/**`). L2 PASS at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, same head, `Security-touching: yes`, so the `security` label goes on. It waits for the maintainer's approval and merge.
